none: PAS NLM-5D71D6: Roman Coin: Denarius of Julia Paula from Wickenby
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver. Coin. Commemorative Denarius of Julia Paula (219-220). Obverse description: Coiffed bust laureate draped right, crudely modelled. Obverse inscription: DIVA PAV(----). Reverse description: Peacock standing right. Reverse inscription: (CO)NSECRATIO. Diameter: 18.5mm, Weight: 2.07gms, die axis: 12. Part of this coin is lost along an angular or serrated break
